This happens when the login shell is zsh or tcsh (and csh on Mac because csh==tcsh). It seems like they both reset the terminal settings when control is returned after a command, so the changes are never seen by the `stty -a` call.

labels.description: An issue that has been verified to require only test changes, not just a test failure.
labels.name: Testing

labels.description: The path to resolution is known, but the work has not been done.
labels.name: NeedsFix
